changesMade: Lead block (181:502) below lg: replaced the bottom-park (`mt-auto mb-9`) with the spec's flow placement `mt-16` (64px = --space-3xl) directly under the title, keeping `self-center` and `w-[calc(100%-48px)]` / `md:w-[min(431px,72vw)]`. Mechanism: the block was pinned to the foot of the stage by `margin-top: auto`, which at 768 and 390 lands it on the hull and the dark water, so the 48% quiet run measured ~1.3:1 and four of five lines were unreadable. Spec Section 1 / Responsive says 768-1023 `align-self: center; margin-top: 64px` sitting under the title, and < 768 `width: calc(100% - 48px)` in the same position - that band is the quiet sky the 48% colour was drawn against. The lg branch (96px below the title, right gutter, 431px) is untouched.

Stage min-height 42.5rem -> 38.75rem (620px), the spec's `< 768` floor. Mechanism: the 680px value existed only to open enough water at the foot of the stage for the bottom-parked lead; with the lead back in flow under the title the compensation is dead weight and the drawn value applies again.
summary: Moved the hero lead + CTA out of the bottom-of-stage park and back into normal flow 64px under the title at tablet and mobile (spec Section 1 responsive), so the 48% quiet run sits on quiet sky instead of the dark hull and water.
notFixed: Vessel plate too dark (CRITICAL, all breakpoints) - BLOCKED. The code applies no opacity and no mix-blend-mode to the vessel (verified in hero-stage.client.tsx and the four hero utilities in globals.css), so the darkening is in the exported raster: spec Section 1 notes 247:655 composites TWO image fills and must be exported as one flattened asset, but src/app/(home)/assets/hero-vessel.png was resolved from a single imageRef via /v1/files//images, so it carries only the lower/darker fill. The fix is to re-render node 247:655 through the Figma render endpoint (which flattens both fills) and overwrite that PNG. This turn's rules put binary assets off-limits and auto-revert any change to them, so it has to be applied as its own asset pass.

Exposure / Matter faces (CRITICAL, all breakpoints) - BLOCKED. No WOFF2 for either family exists in the repo, and the wiring lives in src/app/fonts.ts, src/app/layout.tsx and src/app/globals.css, all shared files owned by other agents this pass. The fallback stacks are already named correctly there; landing the real faces is a shared-file change.

margin-top 148px / 96px flagged as arbitrary by the measurement gate - kept. Both are literal spec values (Section 1: title top 148px, title block -> lead block 96px), both sit on DESIGN.md's 4px base unit with named tokens (--space-6xl, --space-4xl). The audit's token list tops out at 64px, so snapping them would be an 84px/32px fidelity regression.
